description.value:
A compressed, crackling sphere of lightning 5 feet across springs into being in an unoccupied space within range and persists for the duration. Each creature within 5 feet of it when it appears must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 lightning damage, half as much on a success.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can drive the sphere up to 30 feet in any direction. If you crash it into a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 kinetic damage (half as much on a success), and the sphere halts for the remainder of that turn.

Cast with a 6th-level slot or higher, both the lightning and kinetic damage increase by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

system.source: EC Powers — Dark Side Powers, Level 5
